verdict.rationale: The job-creation endpoint documents an option that, when enabled, adds a speaker_id to each transcript segment based on the speaker's voice. It also offers multi-channel speaker parsing, with one speaker assigned per channel. Together these let a developer request diarization and get segments labeled by speaker. Missing for 10: details on speaker-count hints or controls, word-level speaker attribution, sample diarized output or accuracy data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
